judgments.concern: Face-attached depth window: for each successful call of estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2, width and height written on the stage-2 outcome and on PalletPoseStamped after deferred_source_indices are the factory face that call already matches, params.pallet_width_m and params.pallet_height_m, and the search template stays that face. The face-centre position and yaw stay the pose, and pose.position.z stays the range of that centre in the RGB optical frame. The admitted source index and the deferred source indices stay the lists published_admission_split already writes. Depth is the length behind that face along the camera-facing normal, measured from this capture's returns before return, while samples.points_depth_frame, the oriented plane, and best_pose are still locals, and stored on the outcome so publish_pose copies the three scalars. Of the points sample_face_points already returned, project each with project_points_to_plane_2d, subtract best_pose.tx and best_pose.ty, and apply the inverse of the row map transform_points_2d uses, the same map at minus best_pose.theta_rad. Keep a point when those prototype coordinates lie inside the factory rectangle, absolute x at most half of pallet_width_m and absolute y at most half of pallet_height_m, closed on the boundary. The contribution is the negation of the signed point_to_plane_distance. Sort those contributions, start at the one closest to zero, and grow the window while each step to the next kept contribution is at most pallet_height_m. depth_m is the greatest contribution in that window. No second length is substituted, and no flag is written. This pass does not draw from the node rng. A failed estimate still publishes no PalletPoseStamped, and the failure diagnostic stays the admission lists it already carries. The two early returns in on_pair stay silent. Stage 2 still runs once, on the one candidate the admission split already admits. The proposal is that factory face plus the far side of the returns inside that face which stay within one face-height step of the face plane. It does not restate dimension_error_m (the named penalty on pallet width, height, and depth in metres) or latency_ms (the named penalty on measured inference latency).

Optical depth of the two fork openings: for each successful call of estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2, width is params.pallet_width_m and height is params.pallet_height_m, the factory face cached_prototype already passes to build_default_pallet_prototype, and the search template stays that face. The face-centre position and yaw stay the pose, and pose.position.z stays centre_r.z(). The admitted source index and the deferred source indices stay the lists published_admission_split already writes. The two openings are the pocket centres that prototype already cuts, at minus and plus pocket_centre_offset_m on the prototype width axis. Those two points are placed with transform_points_2d at best_pose, lifted with lift_point_from_plane_2d on the same plane basis as the face centre, and mapped into the camera RGB optical frame with apply_se3 of camera_cfg.R_dr and camera_cfg.t_dr. The negative-offset centre is written first, on the outcome and after depth_m on PalletPoseStamped. depth_m is the mean of those two centres' z in that RGB frame, the optical depth of the openings this match placed. On a frontal face the two centres share the face centre's optical depth; on a tilted face they do not, and pose.position.z remains the face centre. This pass does not draw from the node rng. It runs before return, while best_pose and the plane basis are still locals, and publish_pose copies the three sizes and the two centres. A failed estimate still publishes no PalletPoseStamped, and the failure diagnostic stays the admission lists it already carries. The two early returns in on_pair stay silent. Stage 2 still runs once, on the one candidate the admission split already admits. The proposal is that factory face, the optical depth of those two openings, and the two centres on the pose result. It does not restate dimension_error_m or latency_ms.

Prototype face and face-centre range on the size fields: for each successful call of estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2, width is params.pallet_width_m and height is params.pallet_height_m, the prototype sizes cached_prototype already passes to build_default_pallet_prototype, and the search template stays that face. Depth is the face-centre range this call already stores as pose.tz: centre_r.z() from lift_point_from_plane_2d and apply_se3, the z of that centre in the camera RGB optical frame, which publish_pose already copies into pose.position.z. That same scalar is depth_m. Those three scalars and has_dimensions are set on the outcome before return, and has_dimensions is true on that success. publish_pose copies has_dimensions, width_m, height_m, and depth_m onto the rich message after deferred_source_indices. The face-centre position and yaw stay the pose. The admitted source index and the deferred source indices stay the lists published_admission_split already writes. A failed estimate leaves has_dimensions false, publishes no PalletPoseStamped, and the failure diagnostic stays the admission lists it already carries. The two early returns in on_pair stay silent. Stage 2 still runs once, on the one candidate the pose node admits. The geometry_msgs pose stays a header and a pose. The proposal is that copy of the prototype face and that optical-frame z onto the size fields, with has_dimensions true on success. It does not restate dimension_error_m or latency_ms.
